verses.text: The words of Amos, who was among the shepherds of Teko'a, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzzi'ah king of Judah and in the days of Jerobo'am the son of Jo'ash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
And he said:
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon the house of Haz'ael,
I will break the bar of Damascus,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon the wall of Gaza,
I will cut off the inhabitants from Ash'dod,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon the wall of Tyre,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon Te'man,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah,
and their king shall go into exile,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon Moab,
I will cut off the ruler from its midst,
Thus says the LORD:
So I will send a fire upon Judah,
Thus says the LORD:
they that trample the head of the poor into the dust of the earth,
they lay themselves down beside every altar
“Yet I destroyed the Am'orite before them,
Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt,
And I raised up some of your sons for prophets,
“But you made the Naz'irites drink wine,
“Behold, I will press you down in your place,
Flight shall perish from the swift,
he who handles the bow shall not stand,
and he who is stout of heart among the mighty
Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O sons of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
“You only have I known
“Do two walk together,
Does a lion roar in the forest,
Does a bird fall in a snare on the earth,
Is a trumpet blown in a city,
Surely the Lord GOD does nothing,
The lion has roared;
Proclaim to the strongholds in Assyria,
“They do not know how to do right,” says the LORD,
Therefore thus says the Lord GOD:

Thus says the LORD: “As the shepherd rescues from the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the people of Israel who dwell in Samar'ia be rescued, with the corner of a couch and part of a bed.”
“Hear, and testify against the house of Jacob,”
“that on the day I punish Israel for his transgressions,
I will strike the winter house with the summer house;
“Hear this word, you cows of Bashan,
The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness
And you shall go out through the breaches,
“Come to Bethel, and transgress;
offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened,
“I gave you cleanness of teeth in all your cities,
“And I also withheld the rain from you
so two or three cities wandered to one city
“I struck you with blight and mildew;
“I sent among you a pestilence after the manner of Egypt;
“I overthrew some of you,
“Therefore thus I will do to you, O Israel;
For behold, he who forms the mountains, and creates the wind,
Hear this word which I take up over you in lamentation, O house of Israel:
“Fallen, no more to rise,
For thus says the Lord GOD:
For thus says the LORD to the house of Israel:
but do not seek Bethel,
Seek the LORD and live,
O you who turn justice to wormwood,
He who made the Pleiades and Orion,
who makes destruction flash forth against the strong,
They hate him who reproves in the gate,
Therefore because you trample upon the poor
For I know how many are your transgressions,
Therefore he who is prudent will keep silent in such a time;
Seek good, and not evil,
Hate evil, and love good,
Therefore thus says the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord:
and in all vineyards there shall be wailing,
Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD!
as if a man fled from a lion,
Is not the day of the LORD darkness, and not light,
“I hate, I despise your feasts,
Even though you offer me your burnt offerings and cereal offerings,
Take away from me the noise of your songs;
But let justice roll down like waters,
“Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
You shall take up Sakkuth your king, and Kai'wan your star-god, your images, which you made for yourselves;
therefore I will take you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of hosts.
“Woe to those who are at ease in Zion,
Pass over to Cal'neh, and see;
O you who put far away the evil day,
“Woe to those who lie upon beds of ivory,
who sing idle songs to the sound of the harp,
who drink wine in bowls,
Therefore they shall now be the first of those to go into exile,
The Lord GOD has sworn by himself

And when a man’s kinsman, he who burns him, shall take him up to bring the bones out of the house, and shall say to him who is in the innermost parts of the house, “Is there still any one with you?” he shall say, “No”; and he shall say, “Hush! We must not mention the name of the LORD.”
For behold, the LORD commands,
Do horses run upon rocks?
you who rejoice in Lo-de'bar,
“For behold, I will raise up against you a nation,
Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, he was forming locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
When they had finished eating the grass of the land, I said,
The LORD repented concerning this;
Then I said,
The LORD repented concerning this;
And the LORD said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” And I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said,
the high places of Isaac shall be made desolate,
For thus Amos has said,
And Amazi'ah said to Amos, “O seer, go, flee away to the land of Judah, and eat bread there, and prophesy there;
but never again prophesy at Bethel, for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a temple of the kingdom.”
Then Amos answered Amazi'ah, “I am no prophet, nor a prophet’s son; but I am a herdsman, and a dresser of sycamore trees,
and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’
“Now therefore hear the word of the LORD.
Therefore thus says the LORD:
Thus the Lord GOD showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.
And he said, “Amos, what do you see?” And I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then the LORD said to me,
The songs of the temple shall become wailings in that day,”
Hear this, you who trample upon the needy,
saying, “When will the new moon be over,
that we may buy the poor for silver
The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob:
Shall not the land tremble on this account,
“And on that day,” says the Lord GOD,
I will turn your feasts into mourning,
“Behold, the days are coming,” says the Lord GOD,
They shall wander from sea to sea,
“In that day the fair virgins and the young men
Those who swear by Ash'imah of Samar'ia,
I saw the LORD standing beside the altar, and he said:
“Though they dig into Sheol,
Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel,
And though they go into captivity before their enemies,
The Lord, GOD of hosts,
who builds his upper chambers in the heavens,
“Are you not like the Ethiopians to me,
Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom,
“For behold, I will command,
All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword,
“In that day I will raise up
that they may possess the remnant of E'dom
“Behold, the days are coming,” says the LORD,
I will restore the fortunes of my people Israel,
I will plant them upon their land,
